target.cycle: E_r={e_0,...,e_(T_r-1)} is the AL canonical Enterprise native turn cycle, with T_r=C_E(r)

source.fibers: F_(r,k) are the AM canonical closed radial-incidence source fibers for target turn e_k
source.source_arc_measure: Arc_perp is the orthogonal/source arc measure only
source.pushforward_atom: mu_r({e_k})=Arc_perp(F_(r,k)); closed-fiber endpoint overlaps have Arc_perp-measure zero
source.angular_form: mu_r({e_k})=r*Delta_(r,k), where Delta_(r,k) is the source angular width of the fiber in radians
